UNPAID_PROPORTIONAL.label: Unpaid installments, in proportion
UNPAID_PROPORTIONAL.hint: Each unpaid installment gets a share in proportion to what is still owed on it. Paid installments are not touched.

UNPAID_EQUAL.label: Unpaid installments, equally
UNPAID_EQUAL.hint: The same amount comes off each unpaid installment.

LAST_FIRST.label: From the last installment
LAST_FIRST.hint: Comes off the last installment first, then the one before it, until it is used up.

NEXT_FIRST.label: From the next installment
NEXT_FIRST.hint: Comes off the next installment due first, then the one after it.

CUSTOM.label: Custom amount per installment
CUSTOM.hint: Type how much comes off each unpaid installment. The discount is their total.

ALL_PROPORTIONAL.label: All installments, including paid ones
ALL_PROPORTIONAL.hint: The original way: every installment, paid or not, takes a share. A paid installment can end up overpaid.

stopDues.heading: Stop dues
stopDues.hint: For a learner who dropped out or stopped paying. What you stop is no longer due, overdue or reminded. Money already paid and its receipts stay. You can reopen it while the learner is enrolled.

stopDues.removePackage_other: Also remove the learner from all {{count}} courses of the package
stopDues.removeWarning: Access ends now, and the stopped dues can no longer be reopened.
